purpose: Test a bounded cross-family claim that a source-selected prior improves final decision utility under a fixed information, search, verification, and cost contract.
claim_boundary: This contract can support stable performance across the registered task families; it cannot establish mathematical universality over arbitrary optimization problems.

families.name: inventory
families.requirement: Reuse the feasible [0.4,0.9] contract, retain every predeclared target block, and keep the v2 block as adverse evidence.

families.name: queue
families.requirement: Freeze a public candidate bank with at least two feasible candidates and a nontrivial feasible objective span before target observations.

families.name: energy
families.requirement: Use a three-head target contract with paid replication for objective, constraint mean, and log variance; the existing two-head energy archive is not sufficient.

primary_estimand: paired final true expected verification reward: source_selected_structure minus target_only_rbf_kg, with the same candidate bank, initial points, target budget, keyed observation streams, and independent verifier within each target block
secondary_estimands: source calls and target calls separately charged

target_blocks.rule: Freeze the complete seed list before any new target outcome is read; no block may be dropped for infeasibility, apparent negative transfer, or verifier failure.

preflight.if_failed: Do not run the family as a decision comparison; report the contract failure and do not pool it with the other families.

success_gate.primary: Pooled paired 95 percent confidence interval for source_selected_structure minus target_only_rbf_kg has a strictly positive lower endpoint.
success_gate.family_consistency: Every registered family has a nonnegative point estimate and no family has a negative paired interval beyond the predeclared tolerance.
success_gate.safety: False certificates remain zero and certification is not materially lower than target_only_rbf_kg.
success_gate.mechanism: The source-selected arm must retain a positive contrast against same_source_full_dictionary in the same contract; otherwise a generic representation effect cannot be separated from source selection.
success_gate.failure_action: If any primary gate fails, retain the result as bounded or negative evidence and do not use stable or universal source-prior wording.

frozen_controls.mature_baseline: Include an official external baseline only when its candidate feasibility and three-head information contract are complete; otherwise mark it unavailable rather than substituting incompatible rows.

current_evidence_status.inventory_v2: negative independent confirmation of source-selected versus same-source full dictionary
current_evidence_status.inventory_rbf: source-selected is not superior to generic target-only RBF-KG
current_evidence_status.energy: existing source-design result lacks the required three-head target contract
